metadata.title: 📜 Money Quote: Palo Alto Networks CEO

content.text:
June 3, 2026 7:19am ET
📜 Money Quote: Palo Alto Networks CEO
📣 "Six months ago, cybersecurity stocks were doomed because AI was going to protect every one of us and we were all out of a job, right? And suddenly, we're hiring more people. AI is not taking jobs away...We officially declare the SaaS-Pocalypse for cybersecurity dead."
—Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora, on an earnings call last night. Shares in Palo Alto have nearly doubled since April.
